review.assessment: The change correctly implements `slugify` as requested. It processes the string character-by-character, keeping only ASCII alphanumeric characters (lowercased) and stripping all others. The use of a `pending_sep` flag effectively collapses consecutive punctuation/spaces into a single hyphen, while the empty-output check prevents leading separators. This matches the example output (`"My First Post!"` → `"my-first-post"`) and handles typical title edge cases cleanly.
